answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 32437 Country: Canada Title: There is a girl that i wish to marry but i did not know whether i should continue to pursue the marriage or not so i made istikhara and asked Allah to put it in my heart to propose to her, or just leave it. Question: There is a girl that i wish to marry but i did not know whether i should continue to pursue the marriage or not so i made istikhara and asked Allah to put it in my heart to propose to her, or just leave it. Dream: Dream: firstly me and my father are in line for a long time waiting to go in somewhere, no idea where and we are in line for about 2-3 hours and there are 2 other people in line. Across the street is a cafe so we're like lets go eat and then we will come back. Once we get to the cafe the line fills up, me and my dad get angry but choose rather to go eat then wait in line. Anyways we go to the cafe and order something now while we are waiting for the food to come this old small black clothed lady comes up to me and rips a hair outta my leg and starts doing black magic, so im scared and feel weirded out like wat is she doing. Then later on were at home now and im making sajda and after i say my salam same lady short old black clothed lady jus making black magic Answer ID: 32437 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1187/748/H=1432) The summary and meaning of your istikhara and dream is that you should stop thinking about nikah with the said girl mentioned in the question, and follow the advice, instruction and proposal of your parents. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
